The pending FIFO is unbounded and need NOT be empty. Preserve every queued admission and its unstarted attempt/deadline; drain only the active evaluation after fencing subsequent claims.

Plan-only preparation: keep the actual held worker online with normal host self-checks and runner heartbeats. After the active evaluation completes, require the canonical scoring lock to be available; native prepare does not require worker absence or an inventory census.

Rehash the exact native operator and configuration before execution. The native program owns its lock: do not add an outer flock.
Require the new plan and execution/results claims to be absent; an uncertain or failed one-use execution is not automatically retryable.
